priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore listener removal in the returned cleanup function
findings.body: The function still registers the handler but now returns a no-op, so callers cannot detach it. After cleanup, messages continue invoking stale handlers, and repeated attach/cleanup cycles accumulate duplicate listeners and retained references.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts still registers the handler with socket.on("message", handler) at line 2, while the cleanup returned on changed line 3 remains a no-op. The full diff shows this PR removed socket.off("message", handler), so cleanup cannot detach the listener.
